{{Top|leg}}
The '''First Temple of Prime''' was a religious institution on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the temple celebrated the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] war hero [[Alto Stratus]] by mathematically converting the words of his twelve [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] long speech given to his [[Jabiimi Nationalists|troops]] before the [[Battle of Shelter Base]] into a fractal banner.<ref name="Shadowfeed">{{InsiderCite|69|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:9:08 Edition}}</ref>
